999008199.text: リンデ祭当日に急遽、このような招集がかかるとは

localizations.en: I didn't expect to be summoned like this on the day of the Linde Festival.

999008199.text: ええ。お茶会では久しぶりね、ワルター、ジェロン

localizations.en: Indeed. It's been quite a while since we've had a tea party, hasn't it, Walther? Geron?

999008199.text:
まったくだ。こんな風にお茶会で集めるなんて、
国の手に落ちてから一度もなかったな

localizations.en: That's for sure. We haven't gathered for a tea party like this once since we fell under the kingdom's watch.

999008199.text:
罪を償っている立場で、怪しげな行動は控える。
それが共通の認識だったはずだが？

localizations.en: Given our position as people atoning for our crimes, we should be avoiding suspicious activities. I thought that was our shared understanding?

999008199.text:
あら、そんなに毛を逆立てちゃって。
私って信用がないのね

localizations.en: My, you're so on edge. Don't you trust me?

999008199.text:
王国との取引をしたララはともかく、
お前やアンチュもいまだ要注意対象だろう

localizations.en: Lara aside, since she struck a deal with the kingdom... you and Antje are still subjects of close scrutiny, aren't you?

999008199.text:
私は今、国からの指令が数多く舞い込み、
非常に多忙で、充実しています

localizations.en: Currently, I'm receiving numerous assignments from the kingdom. I'm extremely busy, but it's fulfilling work.

999008199.text:
とはいえ、先輩にも恩があります。
先輩の無茶振りは、できるだけ対応しますが……

localizations.en: That said, I do owe you a debt. I'll do my best to accommodate your requests...

999008199.text: あまりに過激なのは勘弁願いますよ

localizations.en: But please, spare me anything too extreme.

999008199.text:
俺もすでに王国に忠誠を誓った身。
離反を疑われるような悪ふざけはできないぞ？

localizations.en: I've already sworn my loyalty to the kingdom. I can't afford to participate in any pranks that might make them suspect my allegiance.

999008199.text: ふふ。本気で警戒されていますわよ、クリセルダ？

localizations.en: Hehe. They're genuinely wary of you, Criselda.

999008199.text:
ええ。それが錬金党だものね。
懐かしいわ、この感覚……

localizations.en: Yes. That's what it means to be part of the Polar Night Alchemists. How nostalgic, this feeling...

999008199.text:
でも今日招いたのは、リンデ祭を一緒に祝いたかった
……いえ、祝ってほしかったからなの

localizations.en: But I invited you all today because I wanted to celebrate the Linde Festival together... No, because I wanted you to celebrate with me.

999008199.text: 今まで、そしていつもありがとう、ってね

localizations.en: To say thank you—for everything until now, and always.

999008199.text: これはジェロンと弟くんに

localizations.en: This is for you and your brother, Geron.

999008199.text:
毛並みを整える精油を調合してみたの。
獣化の呪いで傷んでしまっているでしょう？

localizations.en: I synthesized an essential oil for grooming your fur. The curse of beast transformation has damaged it, hasn't it?

999008199.text: あ、ああ……
ワルター、これを受け取ってちょうだい
おお。どれも貴重な素材ではないですか！

localizations.en: Oh my. These are all precious materials!

999008199.text:
ふふ。集めるのに苦労したのよ？
研究の役に立つんじゃないかしら？

localizations.en: Hehe. It took quite some effort to gather them, you know? I thought they might be useful for your research.

999008199.text:
ええ、もちろんです！
わざわざ探してくる時間と手間が省けましたよ！

localizations.en: Yes, absolutely! You've saved me the time and trouble of hunting them down myself!

999008199.text: 本当に現金……
ララにはこれを。手荒れ防止になると思うわ

localizations.en: And for you, Lara. I think this will help prevent your hands from getting rough.

999008199.text:
あら。気付かれてしまいましたか。
王の佇まいに隙があってはいけませんのに

localizations.en: Oh my. You noticed? A queen must maintain her regal bearing without any flaws.

999008199.text:
あなたは自ら働く王だもの。
恥ではないし、時には手だって荒れるわよ

localizations.en: You're a hands-on ruler, Lara. There's no shame in that, and sometimes your hands will get rough.

999008199.text:
そういうことでしたら、ありがたく。
あなたの調合でしたら、効果は抜群ですわね

localizations.en: If you put it that way, then I'll gratefully accept. Coming from you, I'm certain it will be highly effective.

999008199.text: それから……アンチュには、これを

localizations.en: And finally... Antje, this is for you.

999008199.text: ……ネックレス？

私のとお揃いで作ったの。私のアンチュには、
いつも私を身近に感じてほしいから

localizations.en: I made a matching pair. I want you, my dear Antje, to always feel me close by.

999008199.text: うん……うん！　嬉しい……ありがとう

localizations.en: Yeah... Yeah! I'm so happy... Thank you.

999008199.text: 極夜の錬金党党首として、みんなには改めて感謝を

localizations.en: As the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists, I want to thank you all once more.

999008199.text:
あなたたちのおかげで、私はパルメ族の存在を
表舞台に引きずり出すという本懐を遂げられた

localizations.en: Thanks to all of you, I was able to accomplish my goal of dragging the Palme's existence into the light.

999008199.text:
その過程で、あなたたちの存在は
私の心の支えになってくれていた

localizations.en: Throughout that journey, each of you became a pillar of support in my heart.

999008199.text: クリセルダ……

それぞれの渇望で結ばれた絆だけれど、
私にはかけがえのない時間だった

localizations.en: Though we were bound together by our individual yearnings, those moments were irreplaceable to me.

999008199.text: 今まで――ありがとう

それぞれ新たな渇望のために動いている今、
錬金党はもう、役割を終えたわ

localizations.en: Now that we're each pursuing new yearnings, the Polar Night Alchemists have fulfilled their purpose.

999008199.text: ク、クリセルダ……？

ずっと正式には言えなかったけれど……
極夜の錬金党党首として、最後に伝えるわ

localizations.en: I was never able to formally say this before... but as the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists, I'll tell you now.

999008199.text: ここで……極夜の錬金党を解散する

localizations.en: Here and now... I'm dissolving the Polar Night Alchemists.

999008199.text:
研究者肌の錬金術士で、元「極夜の錬金党」。
現在は国の監視下で、研究や調査に協力している

localizations.en: A research-minded alchemist and former member of the Polar Night Alchemists. Currently cooperating with research and investigations under the kingdom's supervision.
